# DAWproject 1.0 schema

`Project.xsd` and `MetaData.xsd` from the DAWproject repository (https://github.com/bitwig/dawproject, commit ee4dcdde75940f30e14e55401a26955a58b8322b), unchanged, with its `LICENSE` (MIT, Copyright (c) 2020 Bitwig). Used only by `tests/test_dawproject.py` and the browser test to validate the DAWproject export (EXP.3); it is not served by the app.
